name: securitytrails_domain
description: Domain intel (DNS, subdomain count) for <hostname>. Returns current A/MX/NS records, subdomain count, and Alexa rank. Example: securitytrails_domain({ hostname: "github.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: SecurityTrails API key (get one free at securitytrails.com — 50 lookups/mo)

name: securitytrails_subdomains
description: Enumerate subdomains of <hostname>. Returns the subdomain labels plus fully-qualified domains. Example: securitytrails_subdomains({ hostname: "github.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })

hostname.description: Apex domain / hostname to enumerate, e.g. "github.com"

name: securitytrails_dns_history
description: Historical DNS records for <hostname>. Returns past record values with first/last-seen dates for a given record type (a, aaaa, mx, ns, soa, txt). Example: securitytrails_dns_history({ hostname: "github.com", type: "a", _apiKey: "your-key" })

type.description: DNS record type: a, aaaa, mx, ns, soa, or txt (default "a")

name: securitytrails_whois
description: WHOIS for <hostname>. Returns registrar, creation/expiration dates, and registration contacts. Example: securitytrails_whois({ hostname: "github.com", _apiKey: "your-key" })
